result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: a duplicate restaurant card appears side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The restaurant card for 'Green Bowl Poké' (with identical image, '15–25 min' delivery time, and '€0.90 delivery' fee) is duplicated consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate items in the 'Fastest near you' data feed or frontend rendering logic so each restaurant appears only once in the carousel.
